author: tim_cook
text: Stories have the power to move us, inspire us, and bring us closer together. Congrats to the Apple TV creators, cast, and crews behind the incredible work celebrated at the Emmys for Widow’s Bay, Pluribus, Slow Horses, Margo’s Got Money Troubles, Palm Royale, and Mr. Scorsese!
